metaDescription: Turn a selfie into a pro headshot, restore an old photo or become a 3D figurine in one tap, then refine it by chat. 5 free edits a day for your first 7 days.

heroHeadline: Edit any photo in one tap
heroSubhead: Pick a photo, tap an edit: a pro headshot, a restored old photo, a 3D figurine. Then refine it by chat. Standard runs on Google's Nano Banana 2.1, Max on OpenAI's GPT Image 2.5.

features.title: One-tap edits
features.body: Pro headshot, a four-shot headshot pack, old-photo restore, 3D figurine, natural retouch, white background, anime style, magazine cover, new outfit or hairstyle, travel photo, royal pet portrait, a holiday card and a Halloween costume.

features.title: Refine by chat
features.body: Each message edits your latest image: "make the blazer navy", "put her in a bright office". Or describe a brand-new picture from scratch.

features.title: Before and after
features.body: Save results to Photos, or share the original and the edit side by side in one tap.

features.title: Two levels of quality
features.body: Standard runs on Nano Banana 2.1 and suits most edits at one edit per image. Max runs on GPT Image 2.5, the most detailed model, at five edits per image. If one model is busy or declines, another takes over.

features.title: Edits, your way
features.body: Your first edit starts 5 free Standard edits a day for 7 days. After that, buy a pack of 10, 40 or 120 edits that never expire, or PixiePocket Plus for 60 edits every week. A request that fails never costs an edit.

features.title: Private by default
features.body: Your images are yours alone: there is no public feed, nothing you make is shown to other users, and choosing a photo never asks for access to your whole library.

howItWorks.body: Choose any photo: a selfie, an old print, your pet. Nothing asks for access to your whole library.
Tap a one-tap edit and the result arrives in seconds, on Nano Banana 2.1 or, for Max, GPT Image 2.5.
Ask for changes in plain words and each message edits the latest image, then save or share the before and after.

faq.a: No. Edit packs of 10, 40 or 120 are one-time purchases that never expire. PixiePocket Plus is optional: 60 edits every week for $6.99, a weekly subscription that renews until you cancel it in your Apple Account settings.

The app is free to download, and your first edit starts 5 free Standard edits a day for 7 days. After that, packs of 10, 40 or 120 edits cost $2.99, $9.99 and $24.99, or PixiePocket Plus gives 60 edits a week for $6.99. A Standard image costs one edit and a Max image five.

faq.q: What can I do in one tap?
faq.a: Turn a selfie into a pro headshot or a pack of four, restore and colorize an old photo, become a 3D figurine, retouch a portrait naturally, cut a subject onto a white background, or try anime, magazine-cover, outfit, hairstyle, travel, royal-pet, holiday-card and Halloween looks.

faq.q: Which AI models does it use?
faq.a: Standard runs on Google's Nano Banana 2.1 and Max on OpenAI's GPT Image 2.5. If one model is busy or declines a request, another takes over.

faq.q: What happens to my prompts and photos?
faq.a: Your prompts and photos are sent to Google Gemini and OpenAI to create your images. You approve this in-app before your first creation and can withdraw consent anytime in Settings.

faq.q: Do I need an account to use it?
faq.a: No. You can start anonymously. To sync your images across devices, sign in with Apple, Google, or GitHub.

faq.q: What if the AI declines my request?
faq.a: Some photos and prompts are declined by content moderation, most often on photos of people. A request that fails never costs you an edit, and rewording it usually works.
PixiePocket runs on iPhone and iPad with iOS 16.6 or later.

faq.q: Is PixiePocket available in my language?
faq.a: Yes. The app speaks English, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Brazilian Portuguese, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese.
